If you would like to know what a finished portrait could look like, get in touch and ask.

Volume II

The atelier

My name is Hanish P, and I draw under the name Scribbleartz. Most pieces begin as small studies in a notebook, such as eyes, faces and hands, before they become a finished sketch.

I work mainly in pen and charcoal. I enjoy fine, patient detail as much as deep shadow, so I can draw anything from an ornamented portrait to a dramatic black and white one.

  • Pen sketches
  • Charcoal sketches
  • Portraits
  • Gifts
Volume III

Commissions

Tell me what you have in mind and I will tell you how I would draw it. Message me for sizes and prices.

I

Pen sketches

Clean, detailed linework for portraits, jewellery and fine ornament.

II

Charcoal sketches

III

Sketches as gifts

For birthdays, anniversaries, weddings or no occasion at all. Send a photo and I will turn it into a keepsake.

Not sure what to ask for? Send the photo and the occasion, and we will decide together.

Volume IV

How a commission works

  1. I

    Message me

    Send a reference photo and tell me who it is for, or what you would like drawn.

  2. II

    Agree the details

    We settle the medium (pen or charcoal), size, timeline and price before I begin.

  3. III

    Sketch and deliver

    I draw it by hand and send you the finished piece.
